newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Q1 gross domestic product up 0.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Q1 gross domestic product up 0.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Kazakhstan's gross domestic product rose by 0.5 percent in January-March of this year compared to the same period last year, a report from the National Statistics Agency said on Monday.
The agency said that in absolute figures the Central Asian state's GDP was 358 billion tenge in the first quarter of 1997.

It said the rise of GDP was largely due to the growth of Kazakhstan's services sector, which currently accounts for 61.9 percent of GDP and rose in January-March by 7.6 percent compared to the same period last year.
